answer: Seeded slot lottery anchoring.** Each epoch, a public verifiable random function (VRF) driven by a dune-indexed beacon derives a slot map binding each agent ID to a rotation window; IDs must reveal a matching preimage to act. An attacker cannot precompute which of their duplicate IDs will land in contested windows, so they must maintain full compute and uptime for every candidate, paying the same per-identity beacon-verification and idle-hosting cost as honest agents — that ferrous cost, multiplied across fakes, is the anchor against cheap mass registration.
